title: Fullbright DamageMeter Zoom Plus
description: Enhance visibility, combat feedback and exploration. This mod combines essential tools into one seamless experience.
body:
# 🌟 Fullbright Zoom Plus

![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.9-brightgreen)
![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.10-brightgreen)
![Minecraft Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-brightgreen)
![Fabric API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Loader-Fabric-blue)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow)

FullbrightZoomPlus is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2. It combines fullbright, zoom, mob health display, and damage meter features in one mod.

Updated for the latest Minecraft Java Edition release, 26.2 (Chaos Cubed), including the new Sulfur Caves and Sulfur Cubes content.

---

![Controls](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/w5Ejgg5z/images/19d7453d93c4074491f42d44e675a68d13395596.png)

## 🚀 Core Features (MC Version 1.21.9 - 1.21.11)

| Key | Function | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **B** | Fullbright | Toggles between normal lighting and 100% brightness. |
| **C** | Zoom | Hold to zoom in (Scroll to adjust). |
| **H** | Mob HP Mode | Cycles through: BossBar -> Labels -> Both -> Off. |
| **J** | Damage Meter | Toggles the visibility of floating damage numbers. |

---

*Developed with ❤️ by Eckelsoft*
